text:
maria_cs: quick notes from Northgrid onboarding call. renewal in ~6w. they raised four asks that affect adoption.

maria_cs: ask 1 - embeddings stale: they push nightly rows but embeddings require manual re-ingest. want incremental refresh or webhook to trigger re-embed on row change.

maria_cs: ask 2 - per-route cost view: finance needs a simple per-route spend CSV and spike annotations. current token UI too noisy.

maria_cs: ask 3 - private rollout control: security asks for a staged allowlist for model variants (canary->baseline->locked) and an API to pin routes to model tags.

maria_cs: ask 4 - onboarding kit: one-pager + curl/terraform example for embedding refresh and cost export.

nina_csm: adding to renewal tracker and tagging @sam_product and @kevin_eng. :pushpin:

sam_product: triage: A) route CSV = quick win, plan next sprint. B) embedding webhook = spike (auth/rate limited), 1-week spike. C) route->model pin = larger, spec for Q2. D) onboarding kit = docs task.

kevin_eng: concur. i'll run 3-day spike to validate webhook auth model. estimate 2 sprints for full feature if spike is ok.

jonah_solutions: i'll draft the sample curl + terraform snippet for the kit and share a prototype lambda for DB->re-embed flow.

maria_cs: thanks. i'll open 3 JIRA tickets (labels: cs-customer-ask) and update Northgrid with timelines: CSV ~2w, webhook spike 1wk, spec Q2.

ops_bot: reminder: sprint planning tomorrow 10:00am PT. add agenda item: Northgrid CSV + embed webhook spike.

sam_product: good. maria pls paste ticket IDs here once created. :thumbsup:
